description: This file defines an interface 'Scenario' within the Eclipse Ditto project, providing static methods for creating scenario setup instances with various parameters, as well as methods to retrieve scenario configurations and properties used in testing enforcers. It focuses on constructing test cases involving policies, authorization contexts, resources, and permissions.

classes.name: Scenario
classes.description: An interface representing different scenarios in testing enforcers, with static factory methods and accessor methods for scenario configurations.

methods.name: newScenarioSetup
methods.description: Multiple overloads to create a ScenarioSetup instance with various parameters including policy, authorization context, resource, permissions, expected result, and optional custom functions or JSON views.

methods.name: newAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Creates a new AuthorizationContext with specified authorization subjects, typically for testing purposes.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the simple name of the scenario class.

methods.name: getSetup
methods.description: Accessor for the ScenarioSetup associated with this scenario.

methods.name: getScenarioGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name of this scenario.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the policy associated with this scenario.

methods.name: getApplyAlgorithmFunction
methods.description: Returns the function that applies the policy algorithm for this scenario.
